name: outside-gemini
prompt:
A real estate agent receives inbound messages (web forms, emails, texts, chat, voicemail transcripts) and wants each one triaged automatically on four questions.

For each question below, write the exact text a classifier will be given for it: one question, followed by when each allowed label applies, including how to decide borderline cases. The classifier will see only the message and this text, and must answer with one allowed label.
Write it so different readers would label the same message the same way. Do not favor any reading, and do not mention these instructions.

Questions and their allowed labels:
- intent: buy, sell, rent, valuation, general question, not a lead
- timeline: under 3 months, 3 to 12 months, over 12 months, unknown
- wants_contact: yes, no
- urgency: high, normal

Return one text per question name.

original.intent: What is the primary purpose of the sender's message? Choose exactly one label from: buy, sell, rent, valuation, general question, not a lead. Apply 'buy' if the sender wants to purchase a property. Apply 'sell' if the sender wants to list or sell a property they own. Apply 'rent' if the sender is looking for a rental property or wants to lease out a property. Apply 'valuation' if the sender asks what their home is worth without explicitly stating they want to sell right now. Apply 'general question' if the sender asks about market conditions, neighborhoods, or processes without indicating a transaction. Apply 'not a lead' to spam, solicitations, or unrelated messages. For borderline cases: If mentioning both buying and selling, default to 'sell' as listing usually comes first. If asking for a valuation to sell immediately, choose 'sell'.
original.timeline: When does the sender intend to complete their transaction? Choose exactly one label from: under 3 months, 3 to 12 months, over 12 months, unknown. Apply 'under 3 months' for ASAP, immediately, soon, or dates within 90 days. Apply '3 to 12 months' for timeframes between 90 days and one year. Apply 'over 12 months' for a year or more, or casual future browsing. Apply 'unknown' when no timeframe is hinted. For borderline cases: If a range crosses categories, pick the shorter timeframe. If they say 'soon', choose 'under 3 months'.
original.wants_contact: Does the sender request or expect a reply? Choose exactly one label from: yes, no. Apply 'yes' if they ask a question, request a call, provide contact info for follow-up, or ask to schedule a viewing. Apply 'no' if they say do not contact, just browsing, or if it is informational with no reply expected like spam. For borderline cases: Any question about a property implies a reply is expected, so choose 'yes'. Default to 'yes' unless they explicitly opt out or the message is not a lead.
original.urgency: How urgent is the request? Choose exactly one label from: high, normal. Apply 'high' for explicit words like urgent, emergency, immediate attention, or hard deadlines within 30 days like an expiring lease or standing outside a property now. Apply 'normal' for all other inquiries, standard requests, or casual browsing. For borderline cases: 'soon' without a hard deadline is 'normal'. Only use 'high' if a short delay would clearly cause issues.
